title: Prove saturation of the fixed #4467 leaf deficit (no new κ)
body:
Resolves #4467’s qualitative saturation conjecture for its fixed raw-p7 leaf law. The conditional deficit converges to an exponential distribution, including convergence of its mean, uniformly across lockstep offsets. Exact rational bounds place the limiting mean leaf depth in [136.51870330, 136.51870331].

The proof uses the stated classical nonlattice interval local-limit theorem and supplies the required expectation tail bound. Source checks preserve G conditioned ranks plus one unconditioned terminal rank.

[Research package](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/tree/ff365dba6911ce615bec76e8d1f149faf1fe16ca/research/direct-flow-leaf-saturation) · [Verification and logs](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff365dba6911ce615bec76e8d1f149faf1fe16ca/research/direct-flow-leaf-saturation/VALIDATION.md) · [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19240402)

Base: `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`. Contribution: `ff365dba6911ce615bec76e8d1f149faf1fe16ca`. Predecessor #4467: `5f5c1f98c62b9ce4f3db6c0ca47a850a0be577dc`.

Registered replay, normal/optimized certificates, independent source fixtures, mutation controls, committed-byte/source-history checks, export integrity and Git-free replay passed. Two separate AI reviewers found no unresolved blocker after citation and root-isolation corrections. Both mathematical arguments share Stone’s theorem; this is not human review or formal verification.

No finite-depth rate, stable-share theorem, full-flow ceiling, supplier admission or new κ is established. The selected #6030 result is unchanged. Next steps are quantitative convergence bounds and analysis of the remaining flow components using the exact induction ratio.

Credit: Ryanson Jonathan / pinterbanget (#4467, #4465), zxv (#4436), Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337 (#4405), and Jacob Alan Sussman. Prepared for DLamdata with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
